(()=>{const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="3D view controls"] button,[aria-label="Model navigation"] button')];return bs.map(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return {text:b.textContent,label:b.ariaLabel,w:r.width,h:r.height,x:r.x,y:r.y,hit:document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2)?.outerHTML.slice(0,180)}})})()
